steps.title: Setup Directory Structure
steps.description: Initialize the directories for package files, assets, resources, and gradle build wrappers.

steps.title: Configure Build Settings
steps.description: Define compiler, targetSDK, minSDK, build tools configurations, and clean dependencies in build.gradle.

steps.title: Define Application Metadata
steps.description: Create global app metadata file assets to deliver static configurations to backend integrations at runtime.

steps.title: Declare Permissions and Entry Points
steps.description: Configure the AndroidManifest.xml with Internet permissions, launch activity targets, and framework application theme.

steps.title: Draft Backend API Client
steps.description: Create the unified high-performance BackendApi engine using native Java HttpURLConnection for register, login, and robust dynamic CRUD payloads.

steps.title: Design Enterprise Visual Interfaces
steps.description: Implement activity_main.xml visual presentation layer, structuring dashboards, dynamic listings, and advanced calculation controls.

steps.title: Develop Interactive Switch Controllers
steps.description: Implement standard interface components, input filters, and validation methods inside MainActivity.

steps.title: Program Dynamic Calculations Module
steps.description: Develop and hook offline computation events to dynamically process live price calculations, totals, subtotals, margins, and cost models.

steps.title: Integrate Dynamic List Adapters
steps.description: Program custom ListAdapters locally inside MainActivity to render synced Client profiles, Inventory statuses, and calculated invoice logs.

steps.title: Verify Registration & Token Flow
steps.description: Test programmatic registration sequence with immediate secondary login trigger, handling dynamic bearer token extraction.

steps.title: Building BizFlow Pro
steps.description: Verify code constraints, finalize dependency structures, construct, compile and assemble the final enterprise-ready software binaries.
